Politics · India

Indian youth protests lead to education minister's resignation

A protest movement, largely driven by Gen Z and fueled by social media satire over an exam scandal, has led to a significant shake-up in India's government. The protests, characterized by humor and the use of Gen Z slang, are seen by some as a challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's administration. The movement's success has been linked to the resignation of the education minister, with some outlets describing it as a victory for the youth and a blow to the government's perceived 'architecture of fear'. Pakistan's interior minister also commented on the situation, warning of a potential 'cockroach uprising' by disgruntled youth.
